The '''Oplovis sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], near the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in Oplovis sector included [[Harrod's Planet]], the planets of the [[Yuvern system/Legends|Yuvern system]], and [[Oplovis]] itself.

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Oplovis sector was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space.<ref name="TEA" />

During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the sector was defended by the [[Oplovis Sector Fleet]].<ref name="RASb">''[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook]]''</ref> Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Oplovis sector attempted to throw off the Empire.<ref name="RECG" /> However, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] turned [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Gaen Drommel]] soon came back to his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Oplovis]] and took the Oplovis sector as his own territory. It was defended by the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Guardian (Executor-class)|''Guardian'']] and the [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]] [[Ketaris/Legends|Ketaris]]. After Drommel's defeat at the [[Battle of Tantive V]], the damaged ''[[Guardian]]'' was stuck in the [[Fardon system]] with an inactive [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. Supervising the repairs of his flagship, Admiral Drommel set up on [[Soullex]] and stayed on this world for over a decade.

[[File:Empire_7-8_ABY.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Oplovis sector and other Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|warlords']] territories ([[7 ABY/Legends|7]] - [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]).]]

Oplovis sector joined [[Thrawn's confederation]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]] and then in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]]. It became part of the [[Dark Empire]] at the time of the [[Operation Shadow Hand|return]] of [[Palpatine/Legends|reborn Emperor Palpatine]]. In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], it was integrated in [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Pellaeon's]] [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] but it was eventually [[Battle of Ketaris|lost]] in [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]].

The Oplovis sector was [[Battle of the Ketaris system|conquered]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] at the beginning of [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. It was eventually liberated by the Imperial Remnant at the end of the war and stayed permanently under Imperial control. During the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], the sector belonged to the [[Roan Fel]]'s [[Empire-in-exile]].
